360Learning Pricing

Team plan: $8 per user per month, up to 100 users. Above that, Business or Enterprise quote.

The published number

$8 per user per month on the Team plan, capped at 100 users, no minimum commitment. Beyond 100 users 360Learning routes you to a Business or Enterprise quote with flexible billing (registered + monthly active users combined).

Tiers published

What 360Learning shows on its pricing page

Notes for buyers

What the tier prices imply

  • At 50 users, Team = $400/month, $4,800/year. The lowest published per-user math in the twelve-vendor set.
  • At 100 users, Team = $800/month, $9,600/year. This is the published-pricing ceiling.
  • Above 100 users, the lever to ask about on a Business quote is whether registered-user or monthly-active-user accounting reduces invoice volatility for your seat curve.
  • 360Learning’s differentiation in the demo is collaborative course authoring and peer-learning workflows; that is the upsell pitch on the Business and Enterprise quotes.

FAQ

360Learning pricing questions

How much does 360Learning cost?

360Learning publishes one rate: the Team plan at $8 per user per month, for up to 100 users, with no minimum commitment. Business and Enterprise plans are custom-quoted. Verified September 2026 on 360learning.com/pricing.

What does 360Learning cost for 50 or 100 users?

On the Team plan’s published $8 per user per month: 50 users is $400 per month ($4,800 per year) and 100 users is $800 per month ($9,600 per year), which is the published-pricing ceiling. Above 100 users 360Learning moves you to a Business or Enterprise quote.

Does 360Learning have a free plan?

There is no perpetual free plan. 360Learning offers a free trial (the current pricing page does not state its length). The only ongoing published price is the $8 per user per month Team plan.

What is 360Learning's pricing model above 100 users?

Quote-only. Business and Enterprise contracts use flexible billing that combines registered users and monthly active users in a single contract, which 360Learning positions for teams mixing internal and external (customer or partner) learners.
